```yaml
name: Brin PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  security_scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: brin-scan-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.11

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Get Commit List
        id: commits
        run: |
          COMMITS=$(git log --pretty=format:"%H" HEAD~${{ github.event.pull_request.commits }}..HEAD)
          echo "commits<<EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "$COMMITS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Initialize Comment
        id: comment_init
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ## 🛡️ Brin Security Scan Results
            
            Scanning commits for potential security issues...
            
            <!-- brin-scan-comment -->
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: brin-scan-comment
          mode: create-if-not-exists

      - name: Scan Commits with Brin
        id: scan
        run: |
          set -e
          FAILED=false
          RESULTS=""
          COMMIT_COUNT=0
          
          while IFS= read -r commit; do
            COMMIT_COUNT=$((COMMIT_COUNT + 1))
            echo "Scanning commit: $commit"
            
            # Call Brin API for each commit
            RESPONSE=$(curl -sf "https://api.brin.sh/commit/$commit?details=true&mode=full" || echo '{}')
            
            if [ -z "$RESPONSE" ] || [ "$RESPONSE" = "{}" ]; then
              echo "⚠️ Failed to get Brin analysis for commit $commit"
              RESULTS="$RESULTS\n⚠️ Failed to analyze commit $commit"
              continue
            fi
            
            # Parse response
            SCORE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.score // 0')
            VERDICT=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.verdict // "unknown"')
            BLOCKING=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.findings.blocking // [] | length')
            REVIEW=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.findings.review // [] | length')
            INCONCLUSIVE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.findings.inconclusive // [] | length')
            
            # Check if commit is dangerous
            if [ "$VERDICT" = "dangerous" ] || [ "$SCORE" -lt 30 ]; then
              FAILED=true
            fi
            
            # Build result summary
            RESULT="### Commit: $commit\n"
            RESULT="$RESULT**Score:** $SCORE\n"
            RESULT="$RESULT**Verdict:** $VERDICT\n"
            RESULT="$RESULT**Blocking Issues:** $BLOCKING\n"
            RESULT="$RESULT**Review Issues:** $REVIEW\n"
            RESULT="$RESULT**Inconclusive Issues:** $INCONCLUSIVE\n"
            RESULT="$RESULT\n"
            
            RESULTS="$RESULTS$RESULT"
          done <<< "${{ steps.commits.outputs.commits }}"
          
          echo "results<<EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "$RESULTS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          
          if [ "$FAILED" = true ]; then
            echo "failed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "failed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Update PR Comment with Results
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ## 🛡️ Brin Security Scan Results
            
            Scanned ${{ steps.commits.outputs.commits }} commits for security issues.
            
            ${{ steps.scan.outputs.results }}
            
            <!-- brin-scan-comment -->
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: brin-scan-comment
          mode: update

      - name: Fail if Dangerous or Low Score
        if: ${{ steps.scan.outputs.failed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          echo "❌ Security scan failed: One or more commits are marked as dangerous or have low score (< 30)"
          exit 1

      - name: Remove Comment if Clean
        if: ${{ steps.scan.outputs.failed == 'false' }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ## ✅ Brin Security Scan Results
            
            All commits pass security checks.
            
            <!-- brin-scan-comment -->
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: brin-scan-comment
          mode: update
```
